title: Spin Kerr-cat qubits
summary: The use of noise-robust qubit encodings provides a way of extending the lifetime of quantum information at the hardware level. In this work, we introduce the spin Kerr-cat encoding, which leverages a sweet spot near a clock transition in the spectrum of quadrupolar nuclei (having spin $I\geq 1$) to achieve a suppression of charge and magnetic noise leading to qubit dephasing. The basis states of the spin Kerr-cat qubit are given by the two lowest levels of a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric nuclear-spin Hamiltonian and are well approximated by spin cat states for sufficiently high asymmetry…
